test_pytypes_int: test the pybind11 int type binding and its docstring generation
test_pytypes_list: test the pybind11 list type binding with insert, overwrite, append, and print operations
test_pytypes_dict: test the pybind11 dict type binding with key-value access, contains check, and keyword constructor
test_pytypes_capsule: test the pybind11 capsule type with destructor callbacks and named capsule handling
test_pytypes_accessors: test the pybind11 accessor API for attribute access, operator overloading, and tuple accessor
